type Attestation struct
  By string
  Verified bool
  Hop int64
  Program string
  Host string
  User string
  Exe string
  UID int64
  GID int64
  PID int64
  Key string
  Mac string
type Record struct
  Schema int64
  Time string
  Level int64
  Msg string
  Identity []Attestation
  Job string
  Attrs map[string]string
type Page struct
  Outcome PageOutcome
  Records []Record
  Next string
  AtEnd bool
type ApplicationLogTarget struct
  Selection ApplicationLogSelection
  Program string
type ApplicationLogResource struct
  Program string
  CapturedFileKey string
type ApplicationLogPage struct
  Outcome HistoryPageOutcome
  Records []Record
  Next string
  AtEnd bool
type SourceDescriptor struct
  ID string
  Availability SourceAvailability
  Limitations []SourceLimitation
type SourceCatalog struct
  Sources []SourceDescriptor
  Outcome SourceCatalogOutcome
type ProducerClaim struct
  Provider string
  Program string
  Exe string
  User string
  PID int64
  UID int64
  GID int64
type SourceRecord struct
  SourceID string
  Record Record
  Producer *ProducerClaim
type SourcePage struct
  Outcome HistoryPageOutcome
  Records []SourceRecord
  Next string
  AtEnd bool
func Encode(v *Record) []byte
type Refusal struct
  Word string
  Offset int
func (Refusal) Error() string
func Decode(in []byte) (*Record, error)
type FrameWriter interface
  WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
type DispatchError string
func (DispatchError) Error() string
func ServiceName(frame []byte) (string, error)
type FrameExchanger interface
  ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type ServiceError struct
  Code ServiceErrorCode
  Message string
func (ServiceError) Error() string
const EndpointContract
type DescribedService interface
  DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func DescribeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...DescribedService) ([]byte, error)
type ServedService interface
  DescribedService
  ServiceContract() string
func ServeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...ServedService) ([]byte, error)
type Sink interface
  Write(record Record) error
type SinkTransport interface
  FrameWriter
type SinkClient struct
func NewSinkClient(t SinkTransport) *SinkClient
type SinkDispatcher struct
  Handler Sink
func (SinkClient) Write(record Record) (err error)
func (SinkDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (SinkDispatcher) DescribeServiceMetadata() (guarantees []string, capabilities map[string]string)
func (SinkDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (SinkDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
